headline: Markets closed for weekend; Shriram Finance to enter Sensex as Trent exits in upcoming index reshuffle.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian equity markets remain closed today on account of the weekend.
BSE announced Sensex reconstitution, adding Shriram Finance and removing Trent.
Major corporate deal announced between APL Apollo and Tata Steel worth Rs 28,000 crore.
Leadership transition announced at Lodha Developers with Mukund Chitale stepping down.
whatHappening: Shriram Finance will enter the 30-stock BSE Sensex index from December 21, replacing Trent.
APL Apollo agreed to buy Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for Rs 28,000 crore.
Akhil Gupta will replace Mukund Chitale as Chairman of Lodha Developers.
FSSAI reported finding a sample of Bisleri packaged drinking water unsafe.
summary: Indian markets are closed today due to the weekend. Key developments include Shriram Finance entering the BSE Sensex to replace Trent starting December 21. Additionally, APL Apollo announced a major acquisition of Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for Rs 28,000 crore.
